sn56.24:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānam arahanto sammāsambuddhā yathābhūtam abhisambujjhiṃsu || sabbe te cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtam abhisambujjhiṃsu || || Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave anāgatam addhānam arahanto sammāsambuddhā yathabhūtam abhisambujjhissanti || sabbe te cattari ariyasaccāni yathābhūtam abhisambujjhissanti || || Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave etarahi arahanto sammāsambuddhā yathābhūtam abhisambujjhanti || sabbe te cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtam abhisambujjhanti || ||
sn56.24:2.1: Katamāni cattāri || || Dukkham ariyasaccaṃ || dukkhasamudayam ariyasaccaṃ || dukkhanirodham asiyasaccaṃ || dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ || || Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānam arahanto sammāsambuddhā yathābhūtam abhisambujjhiṃsu || abhisambujjhissanti || abhisambujjhanti || sabbe te imāni cattāri ariyasaccāni yathabhūtam abhisambujjhanti || ||
sn56.24:3.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idam dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇiyo ti || ||
